draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold outperformed Fennick-Base on the unseen test sets of the Banking (93.1 vs 91.6) and Travel (92.4 vs 90.9) domains on which it was trained.
rationale: The package evaluates only Banking and Travel (the training domains' unseen test sets, T1.r1, T1.r2). No other domains were evaluated, so the claim that the advantage "may extend" to unseen domains is unsupported speculation; the evidence supports only the observed advantage on the two evaluated domains.
